class.name: crop_box
class.description: Drops the points inside (or outside) a box: the car itself

class.name: ground_height
class.description: Ground: points below a height over base_footprint (flat ground only)

class.name: ground_patchwork
class.description: Ground segmentation after Patchwork++ (CZM, R-VPF, R-GPF, GLE, A-GLE, TGR, RNR)

class.name: height_band
class.description: Keeps obstacle points between two heights over the ground

class.name: pointcloud
class.description: sensor_msgs/PointCloud2 (3D lidar, depth camera) through a filter chain

class.name: depth_image
class.description: sensor_msgs/Image depth with its CameraInfo (a depth camera), every stride-th pixel

class.name: occupancy_grid
class.description: nav_msgs/OccupancyGrid from another node (e.g. a camera)

class.name: direct_projection
class.description: Each source's rays straight into its own 2D layer (the grid of Stage 1)

class.name: sparse_voxel
class.description: Obstacle points kept in 3D voxels, projected by the traversability rules

class.name: multi_level_surface
class.description: Obstacle points kept as height intervals per cell, projected by the traversability rules
